purpose: Make the page—not a long-lived chat—the durable human conversation surface for improving Prometeo.

identity.open_thread_rule: At most one OPEN thread per workspace/page. A future explicit close may start a new thread without deleting history.

objects: exact Capture revision references owned by P4 Capture

human_model.not_primary: a mixed global list of note atoms
human_model.default_view: pending human observations followed by previous execution results

capture_rules: Page context is frozen by Capture at creation/start.
Navigating A -> B -> A assigns new captures back to the correct semantic page thread.
Multiple captures accumulate until HACER freezes exact revisions.
Newer revision of the same Capture supersedes only its older still-pending revision.
Submitted/processed history is never silently rewritten by a later transcript edit.
execution_rules: HACER freezes exact pending revisions plus pending attachments.
Execution result returns to this thread by work_item_id, not by ChatGPT conversation identity.
A follow-up Capture after an execution continues the page thread with previous execution context available to the next agent.

authority.thread_role: PRIVATE HUMAN INTERACTION PROJECTION, NOT PRODUCT AUTHORITY
